note: Cherry's switch (internal/assets/egress.go), off by default. R2 objects are stored as application/octet-stream (served uncompressed with exact Content-Length), so text/data kinds (.plist, .aniproj, .xml, .json) are included alongside the binary/image kinds. The base is the operator's public domain for the R2 bucket and is set only in the config folder, never here.
